WITH part_min_cost AS (
  SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
  FROM partsupp
  JOIN part ON ps_partkey = p_partkey
  WHERE p_size = 15 AND p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
  GROUP BY ps_partkey
),
supplier_min_cost AS (
  SELECT 
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
  JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    AND p.p_size = 15
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'

      SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost)

      WHERE p2.p_size = 15 AND p2.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'

)

  s_acctbal,
  s_name,
  n_name,
  p_partkey,
  p_mfgr,
  s_address,

WITH part_min_cost AS (
  SELECT 
    ps_partkey,
    MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_supplycost
  FROM partsupp
  JOIN part ON ps_partkey = p_partkey
  WHERE p_size = 15 AND p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
  GROUP BY ps_partkey
),
suppliers_with_min_cost AS (
  SELECT 
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
  FROM partsupp ps
  JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
  JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  JOIN part_min_cost pmin ON ps.ps_partkey = pmin.ps_partkey
  WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    AND p.p_size = 15
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
    AND ps.ps_supplycost = pmin.min_supplycost
)
SELECT 
  s_acctbal,
  s_name,
  n_name,
  p_partkey,
  p_mfgr,
  s_address,
  s_phone,
  s_comment
FROM suppliers_with_min_cost
ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC, n_name, s_name, p_partkey
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  c.c_name,
  c.c_custkey,
  o.o_orderkey,
  o.o_orderdate,
  o.o_totalprice,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS sum_extendedprice
FROM
  customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
GROUP BY
  c.c_custkey,
  c.c_name,
  o.o_orderkey,
  o.o_orderdate,
  o.o_totalprice
HAVING
  SUM(l.l_quantity) > 300
ORDER BY
  o.o_totalprice DESC,
  o.o_orderdate
LIMIT 100

WITH min_costs AS (
    SELECT
        ps_partkey,
        MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
    FROM partsupp
    JOIN part ON partsupp.ps_partkey = part.p_partkey

      AND part.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
    GROUP BY ps_partkey
)
SELECT
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    ps.ps_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
FROM min_costs mc
JOIN partsupp ps ON mc.ps_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey

  AND p.p_size = 15

ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey
LIMIT 100

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
  FROM supplier s
  JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
  WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'
  GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone
)
SELECT
  s_suppkey,
  s_name,
  s_address,
  s_phone,
  total_revenue
FROM supplier_revenue
WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MIN(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)
ORDER BY s_suppkey
